recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片白血球增加，除了小而深染的有核細胞（有核紅血球或淋巴球）外，還散在較大的單核球樣細胞，而血小板很少；在幼兒身上這種單核球增多合併有核紅血球與血小板低下的血片，符合幼年型骨髓單核球白血病（JMML）。
features: Low-power peripheral blood smear with increased nucleated cells
Scattered larger mononuclear cells with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm consistent with monocytes
Numerous small dark round nucleated cells, likely nucleated red blood cells and lymphocytes (not distinguishable at this power)
Red cells show mild anisocytosis without obvious schistocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows leukocytosis with an increase in mononuclear cells, including monocytoid cells and numerous small, densely staining nucleated cells that likely represent nucleated red blood cells and lymphocytes. Platelets are markedly decreased. Individual cell detail is limited at this magnification. In a young child, the combination of monocytosis, circulating nucleated red cells and thrombocytopenia is consistent with juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, pending absolute monocyte count, splenomegaly, HbF level and RAS-pathway mutation testing.

ddx.vs: Viral infections show reactive lymphocytes rather than monocytosis with immature myeloid cells and nucleated red cells, and lack RAS-pathway mutations.
CML shows a myelocyte and neutrophil peak with basophilia and is BCR-ABL1 positive, whereas JMML is dominated by monocytes and is BCR-ABL1 negative.
This is morphologically similar but occurs in infants with germline PTPN11 variants and usually regresses spontaneously; germline testing separates them.
